Name: Immersive Unique Children Talk
Author: xiaoleiwen
Description:

[b]-[/b] Your [b]spouse

[b][u]Installation:
[/u][/b]1) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9540]Unique Children Talk[/url]﻿ ([b]required[/b]) into your Mods folder first.
[list]
[*][b][u]Important: Get the latest version (2.7 or above)[/u][/b]
[*]Please [b]read the description there[/b] for how to customize [b]the titles the children call you [/b]and [b]your spouse.[/b]
[/list]2) Install [b]Immersive Unique Children Talk[/b].

* [u]Note for users familiar with the older versions[/u]: The latest release is now a CP mod, so there's no need to overwrite the original UCT files like in the past.
